source: Google Cloud Billing Catalog API (cloudbilling.googleapis.com/v1/services/{id}/skus), list prices. Cloud Run service 152E-C115-5142, Kubernetes Engine CCD8-9BF1-090E. Human-readable pages: https://cloud.google.com/run/pricing and https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/pricing
note: us-central1 and asia-south1 have the same Cloud Run prices. Other regions fall back to these with a note.

cloud_run.gpu_l4_note: L4 without zonal redundancy; with zonal redundancy it is 0.0002909/s. Cloud Run GPU needs at least 4 vCPU and 16 GiB.

free_tier_per_billing_account_month.note: The catalog shows the 2M free requests as the first pricing tier. Free CPU/memory seconds are shared by every app on the billing account, so the estimate does not subtract them.

gke_autopilot.cluster_fee_note: One zonal or Autopilot cluster per billing account is covered by the $74.40/month GKE free tier credit; a ShipCube-wide cluster is shared across apps, so it is not charged to one app.
